laws.summary: Web-chat provider work must use an operator-authorized BrowserController, fail closed on provider security barriers, and preserve exact raw response truth.

The serialized browser-mutation lease covers only opening a new conversation in that tab, attachment selection, prompt entry, submission proof, exact canonical-conversation switching, DOM capture and cleanup; provider generation wait never holds that lease. Within the bounded admitted production window, tasks still waiting to submit have priority over ordinary response patrol. laws.summary: GPT Web feeds bind a governed task identity to bounded parallel conversations and expose exact fresh, same-conversation or provider-verified checkpoint-fork topology without fallback.

clauses.statement: A GPT Web feed must prove its exact fresh, same-conversation or provider checkpoint-fork topology and may never substitute a blank chat, summary replay or mutable parent tail.

required: Every governed GPT feed resolves exactly one topology mode: fresh, same_conversation or forked_from_checkpoint. A checkpoint fork first verifies the exact parent URL, parent user-turn marker and following assistant response hash, performs the provider branch action, proves a distinct child URL with the inherited checkpoint history, and records the action evidence hash plus child history fingerprint before child submission.

Fresh proof records zero pre-submit user and assistant turns with no continuation or fork parent. Same-conversation proof records exact parent and actual URL, parent raw hash, prior marker and new marker. Fork proof records parent checkpoint identity, action evidence, distinct child URL, initial history fingerprint and first child marker. Unsupported, missing or ambiguous provider fork controls fail closed and never degrade to a blank chat or uploaded summary.

Runtime capacity is operator-owned, positive, bounded and configurable without becoming a caller field or a product-mode switch; the default capacity supports at least ten independent in-flight GPT conversations.

Every feed request carries one structured taskIdentity containing an allowlisted labelKey plus bounded sourceProject, taskKind and sourceTaskId machine identifiers. This identity is input-hash-bound and never becomes provider-visible housekeeping. Every GPT feed owns an opaque internal attempt id, a deterministic logical-turn marker derived from immutable task identity and input hash, and a submitted prompt hash. Retries for the same semantic turn keep one marker while changed input receives another; callers never control the marker. Durable provider identity is exactly the canonical conversation URL plus the unique logical-turn marker and, after capture, the response hash. Automatic provider titles are observational only. AGENT must never open a provider rename surface, write a chat title, persist rename debt or run a title-housekeeping worker. As soon as the exact marked user turn exists, the runtime persists its transient URL, ordered attachment proof and turn identity before any post-submit attachment inspection, canonical-URL wait or response polling. A transient /c/WEB: URL is anti-resubmission evidence only: it may never become a routing identity, may never trigger sidebar routing, URL reacquisition or canonical-path validation, and may not replace the still-live exact target while canonicalization is being observed. Only a verified non-WEB canonical /c/ URL may enter the routable conversation binding. A later transient inspection failure resumes the captured turn and may never submit the same semantic turn again. After canonicalization the runtime records the formal conversation URL and releases the submit slot.

A fresh GPT execution is established only on the root path with zero user turns, zero assistant turns, an empty composer, no staged attachment, no pasted-text card and no active generation. When that clean state already exists, the runtime must not issue a redundant New chat click; otherwise the current governed zh-CN ChatGPT DOM accepts only one actionable sidebar anchor whose data-testid is create-new-chat-button, visible text is exactly 新聊天 or New chat, resolved href is the provider root, data-sidebar-item is true, pointer-events is not none, and center-point hit testing resolves back to that same test-id anchor. Responsive duplicates with pointer-events none are non-actionable renderings of the same logical control and are excluded before uniqueness; a history/project section trailing anchor whose aria-label says 新聊天 is a different action and is forbidden as fallback. Any future identity drift requires fresh real-Chrome evidence. After clicking the unique actionable sidebar anchor, the runtime re-proves the complete clean state. ChatGPT may preserve a submitted GrassEye draft in the root composer after the provider has already moved that exact marked turn into a durable canonical conversation. The Gateway may clear that abandoned draft only when the same target atomically proves root path, zero user and assistant turns, no attachment or pasted-text card, no generation, exactly one well-formed internal GrassEye marker in the composer, and the execution ledger resolves that marker to exactly one different GPT execution with a durable non-WEB canonical submission. The guarded clear must recheck the same marker and zero-state boundaries immediately before mutation and then re-prove the empty clean root. A missing, foreign, malformed, duplicate, unsubmitted, transient-only or ambiguously owned marker is never cleared; an unmarked composer is treated as an unknown user draft and must remain untouched. Initial clean-root establishment is one bounded browser transaction whose probes are no faster than once per second. A still-hydrating root, a pending clean-state observation, a composer that is not ready, or zero or multiple actionable sidebar candidates before any click is proven is recovery_pending: it releases the short browser lease, retains the same execution id and may not be persisted as a terminal pre-submit identity fault. Low-level repeated observations do not create new business events; runtime logs report the bounded transaction and state transitions rather than turning every probe into a task restart. A continuation must first prove that its exact parent URL, at least one prior user turn, at least one prior assistant turn and the prior answer have finished hydrating; an empty or partial parent snapshot is recovery_pending before upload or send. A send click is not submission success. Success exists only when exactly one user turn in the exact conversation contains the prepared prompt prefix and exact logical-turn marker suffix, that marked turn is the latest user turn, the canonical /c/ URL is durable, and the URL is not already bound to another fresh execution. Page-global user-turn counts are observational only because provider hydration can change them; they are forbidden as submission identity or retry authority. A provider rebound to a foreign marked turn, duplicate same marker or occupied canonical conversation is discarded as internal recovery and may never be published as a successful send.

Response capture is scoped to the unique marked user turn and the assistant turn after it, and never relies on the page-global last assistant message or model marker echo. In the current Chrome provider DOM, the only governed outer turn identity is one [data-testid^=conversation-turn-][data-turn=user|assistant] element. A provider shell with no non-empty screenshot content and no non-empty image source is not a substantive turn: it is ignored while waiting and can neither become the bound assistant response nor make a completed conversation appear advanced. Legacy article tags, nested data-message-author-role attributes and selector fallbacks are forbidden as a second turn-identity chain.

When expectedOutputKind is generated_image, Gateway does not wait for or persist a text-response checkpoint. It locates exactly one user turn carrying the immutable marker, binds only the immediately following assistant turn, waits until that turn exposes exactly one completed generated-image card and no active generation state, opens that exact card, uses the image viewer's unique save action, and registers exactly one newly downloaded decodable image with original byte hash and an opaque provider output ref. The current generated-image card is governed by its unique visible HTMLElement role=button identity and is not assumed to be a native button tag. The current governed zh-CN viewer save identity is exactly one visible button[aria-label=保存]; title, text aggregation and the retired 下载/Download labels are not fallback identities. Zero such buttons stays pending, more than one fails closed, and any future DOM drift requires new real-Chrome evidence before changing this identity. DOM elements never cross the extension transport boundary; evaluation returns only bounded scalar status, reason and click coordinates. It rejects an advanced conversation, multiple logical image sources, ambiguous viewer actions or multiple new downloads. Page images outside that assistant turn and screenshots are never output artifacts. Resume follows the same image-card-to-viewer-to-save path and never resubmits the marked turn.

Submitted feeds release the browser-mutation lease before provider generation completes; while any admitted task still awaits submit, ordinary response patrol yields. Submission and patrol waiter identity, kind and monotonically increasing ticket persist in one SQLite scheduler ledger, stale process waiters are reclaimed, and patrols enter strictly by the oldest durable patrol ticket. After all admitted submissions are recorded, the patrol loop clicks the exact non-WEB sidebar row selected only by captured canonical conversation identity and verifies the exact marker; a not-yet-materialized automatic sidebar title, a row that is visible but not yet focusable, and the same condition encountered during response-capture preflight or before-poll routing are retryable waiting_provider states rather than terminal failure. They must release the short patrol lease, wait until the next patrol, and must not persist review_required. The operator-owned WEB_CHAT_PATROL_INTERVAL_MS is bounded from one to sixty seconds and defaults to five seconds; it is never a caller field. Each patrol acquires only the short mutation lease.

A ChatGPT answer remains generating whenever the exact assistant turn lacks its completion action or the current main conversation exposes a visible thinking, reasoning, loading or shimmer progress node. A page-global aria-busy owned by sidebar, navigation, composer, upload UI or another non-conversation surface is never generation evidence. Intermediate research prose, tool summaries and citation-verification text are never treated as a completed answer.

Whenever ChatGPT shows the ordinary request-frequency dialog, one process-wide unrouted watcher serves the single physical ChatGPT tab for every in-flight task. The highest-priority survival action is fixed: immediately click the unique acknowledgement such as 明白了, remain on the current conversation without page refresh or reload, and wait for the live DOM to recover before any page operation resumes.

Every web-chat page operation binds to the internally held exact ChatGPT BrowserTargetRef and current BrowserDocumentRef. DOM evaluation, CDP mouse events, CDP text input, CDP scroll, screenshot and file input use the Chrome extension transport without activating Chrome or depending on the foreground tab. The one physical provider tab is transport identity, never conversation identity. After an AGENT process restart, a submitted execution with no in-memory target may reacquire only the exact persisted canonical conversation URL. Exact URL reuse is deterministic: one exact URL tab binds, multiple exact URL tabs is identity ambiguity, and an absent exact URL opens that exact URL; unrelated same-origin tabs are ignored. After binding the physical target, the execution routes only by its exact canonical sidebar pathname.

A sidebar row is actionable only after target-bound DOM evaluation proves its href matches the exact canonical conversation pathname and it is inside the exact ChatGPT target viewport. Multiple visible DOM anchors with the same normalized canonical pathname are duplicate renderings of one logical conversation route, not multiple conversation identities: the runtime must collapse them to that one pathname, choose one actionable rendering by a stable geometry order, click it, then prove the browser pathname equals the persisted canonical pathname and the persisted marker occurs exactly once. Two or more persisted markers, different canonical pathnames claiming the same execution, or multiple physical exact-url tabs remain identity ambiguity and fail closed. If every exact rendering is outside the viewport, the runtime performs target-bound CDP scrolling in that sidebar, re-locates the same canonical route, then dispatches the click to the same target and verifies the marker. DOM existence outside the viewport, provider-title matching, physical wheel fallback, current-active-tab selection and URL-first routing are never click proof.

Immediately after the exact assistant turn is complete, the runtime atomically persists the answer bytes, hash, byte count, capture time and provider page URL as a response checkpoint before artifact projection or cleanup. The execution ledger persists the real capacity lease as soon as it is acquired. The durable checkpoint is already the completed provider result: gateway execution races provider post-processing against the checkpoint and must publish the checkpointed bytes and persisted provider lease as soon as the checkpoint exists. The checkpoint patrol is owned by that race and is stopped in a finally path on provider success, provider failure or checkpoint publication; no failed provider attempt may leave a fifty-millisecond checkpoint poller alive. Artifact projection or cleanup may continue after publication, and any failure appends evidence while preserving response_captured. A legacy checkpoint that predates lease persistence may receive one deterministic checkpoint-recovery lease only after execution id, attempt id, input hash, response hash and checkpoint bytes all match; that recovery lease is persisted before publication. An error after checkpoint persistence may never downgrade that result or return the task to provider polling.

Every execution failure appends a bounded durable failure ledger entry containing occurrence time, attempt id, pre-failure phase, classification, recoverability and a bounded reason. A process exit or later successful recovery never erases the prior failure evidence.

Temporary provider unavailability before or after submission, including an absent or not-yet-acquired controlled provider target, a composer that has not become ready, an incompletely hydrated parent conversation, bounded capacity or rate limiting, browser disconnection, transient network failure, an exact submitted conversation that is not currently locatable, and a pre-submit target-evaluation transport failure, is recovery_pending and retains the same execution id, input hash, logical-turn marker, canonical conversation identity and failure evidence. A target-evaluation syntax failure remains visible as an implementation defect and is blocked by executable-script acceptance, but after a corrected runtime is deployed its unsubmitted persisted execution is recovered with the same execution id rather than being stranded or replaced. Every accumulated failure entry is reclassified independently on recovery; any number of recoverable entries remains recoverable. A newly emitted terminal-state error must append the last real root reason in the same durable error, and recovery must classify that root rather than the terminal wrapper. A legacy unsubmitted execution whose bounded ledger contains only one attempt's synthetic terminal-state echoes without a root has no positive terminal cause: those echoes are evidence only and authorize exactly one same-execution recovery attempt, retaining the execution id and logical-turn marker instead of creating a replacement id. A second rootless attempt is not another restart authority. Retry count and failure-ledger length never promote recoverable provider lookup into a terminal user block. Each individual lookup is bounded and releases the browser lease before the next scheduled recovery. Login, captcha, two-factor, security barriers, multiple physical provider tabs or identity ambiguity require review_required inside the generic gateway; an authorized product factory keeps those conditions as internal recovery_pending while showing its user only processing. If multiple physical tabs are detected after durable submission, the gateway records the exact submitted URL in failure proof and retains the same execution and marker; monitor interference may never authorize a second provider submission. Invalid immutable input identity remains failed.

When an authorized factory discards a polluted or terminal provider attempt and creates a fresh execution id for the same round and input hash, the gateway accepts it only when the internal execute option names the exact currently registered execution id being superseded. The rate ledger atomically transfers ownership to the fresh id; unrelated duplicate owners remain rejected, and neither a ten-second retry loop nor a process restart may be required to clear the old in-memory owner.

Process recovery publishes a valid persisted response checkpoint before attempting to locate the physical tab and never resubmits that provider turn. Without a checkpoint, restart recovery trusts only the persisted input hash, ordered attachment proof, exact canonical conversation URL and marker, then resumes response or generated-image capture on that exact identity. It never reads or uploads the caller's disposable source path again. Missing or mismatched checkpoint input identity, attachment identity, hash or byte count returns review_required. Provider-title drift, absence or duplication is irrelevant because titles are neither queried nor mutated.

Chat search is one bounded UI transaction. Before opening search, before attachment selection and before prompt focus, the provider adapter may close only one visible dialog that contains exactly one Search chats or 搜索聊天 textbox and exactly one Close or 关闭 action. Every search exit, including target-not-found and interruption, must close that exact dialog and verify it disappeared before releasing the browser-mutation lease. Missing or ambiguous classification returns review_required.

A feed with providerContinuationRef must focus and verify its exact parent providerPageUrl before submission. Missing, mismatched or unreachable parent identity returns review_required; the open-new-conversation path is forbidden for that feed.

laws.summary: Amazon invoice batch upload must retain one owner-bound exact Seller Central target across items and must not make target cleanup a per-item success condition.

clauses.statement: Amazon invoice batch upload must retain one owner-bound exact Seller Central target across items and must not make per-item target cleanup a success condition.

appliesTo: docs/法案辅助文件/GrassEye Amazon Invoice Upload Unified Chain 施工图.md
required: The amazon-invoice-upload owner retains one BrowserTargetSession whose exact target identity is refreshed from real Chrome before each item.
The next order detail navigation uses reuse-exact-url inside that owner session and never selects a same-host, active, current, first, or front tab fallback.
Successful upload verification records upload_success without closing the owner target.
Already-uploaded verification records already_uploaded without closing the owner target.
upload_success and already_uploaded must remain distinct in task records, ledger projection, latest lookup, and APP batch rendering.
Tab cleanup, if needed, is a batch/session cleanup concern and must not change per-item upload_success into review_required.
Each reused-tab item must still verify the target order id and invoice action state before upload or already-uploaded judgment.
forbidden: Per-item closeTarget inside upload success verification.
Per-item closeTarget inside already-uploaded verification.
Opening a new Seller Central target for every batch item instead of retaining the plugin-owned exact session.
Selecting a Seller Central target from active/current/front/first tab or same-host fallback.
Treating tab close failure as invoice upload failure after Amazon success or already-uploaded state is verified.

laws.summary: Amazon invoice upload must enter each order through one explicit order-detail navigation, must never refresh that page as recovery, and must advance only after an order-bound explicit DOM terminal signal; elapsed time alone cannot decide the business branch or start the next invoice.

clauses.statement: Amazon invoice upload uses one order-detail navigation per item, never refreshes or reopens the order page, and advances from Manage invoice only after an order-bound explicit DOM terminal signal; elapsed time alone never selects the business branch or starts the next invoice.

appliesTo: docs/法案辅助文件/GrassEye Amazon Invoice Upload Unified Chain 施工图.md
required: The upload flow must call the order-detail owner directly; it must not first open the same sellerCentralEntryUrl through a generic Seller Central entry phase.
Each invoice item performs exactly one BrowserController.open for the order detail and never navigates that item again.

The one order-detail open must use one caller-created browserActionId, consume the structured open result, fail closed on an unsuccessful or mismatched observed URL, and persist one integrity-hashed forensics navigation proof linked to taskId or executionId.

Order-detail navigation logs must contain one truthful started/terminal pair for that browserActionId; readiness observations must use distinct observe-window identities and must never be labelled as open or navigation.
Browser state reads and wait operations are pure observations: they must not create a Chrome window, set or restore a URL, refresh a page, or emit another navigation command.

Start, resume, and direct Amazon invoice missions share one plugin-owned single-flight execution lease for the shared BrowserController; a concurrent second execution fails closed before BrowserController.open.
The terminal timeout aborts the active browser and DOM execution and awaits flow settlement before terminal persistence, lease release, or the next invoice execution.

Order-detail readiness is observed in at most eight consecutive windows for a 16-second maximum; each window is no longer than 2 seconds and must record a structured failure before the next same-page observation begins.
Each order-detail snapshot timeout and poll wait is clamped to the current window's remaining time so eight nominal 2-second windows cannot silently become eight overlong waits.
Every Amazon invoice DOM snapshot has an explicit execution deadline no greater than 1800ms so a low-level Chrome evaluation cannot silently exceed the 2-second business window.

A DOM evaluation exception inside an order-detail observation is converted into that window's structured failure and the next finite same-page observation; it must not bypass the governed window sequence.
Evidence screenshot capture binds the exact targetRef/documentRef and runs through the background CDP target without activating Chrome or changing the operator's foreground tab.

After a failed order-detail observation window, the only allowed next action is another bounded DOM observation on the unchanged page; exhausting eight windows returns review-required failure without refresh or repeat navigation.

After Manage invoice is clicked, existing-invoice discovery uses an AND THEN wait: the unique visible invoice dialog must bind to the current amazonOrderId and expose either a matching uploaded invoice row, a fully rendered upload-ready table and upload action, or the exact no-actions blocker before the flow may branch.
A short elapsed-time deadline must not turn a still-loading Manage invoice dialog into review_required and must not permit the local batch to start the next invoice.

The task-level terminal timeout is an operational abort watchdog only: it aborts and awaits the active flow, returns review_required, and the local batch must stop with the current order retained rather than continue automatically.

A governed local-batch inter-item pacing delay may begin only after the prior single-upload task has returned a formal terminal result and released its browser execution lease; it is outside DOM readiness, navigation, retry, timeout, and business-state judgment.
Upload dialog readiness, file-input readiness, and post-submit success evidence each use an observation timeout no greater than 2 seconds.
Login, captcha, 2FA, amount mismatch, ambiguous DOM, exhausted retry, and final verification failure must fail closed without PDF upload or fake success.
forbidden: Opening sellerCentralEntryUrl and then opening the derived order-detail URL as two normal entry steps for the same item.
Any same-tab order-page refresh helper, recovery refresh, random readiness delay, fallback, compatibility bridge, or shadow branch.
Placing local-batch inter-item pacing inside BrowserController, DOM observation, the single-upload plugin flow, task watchdog, or execution lease.
Using a short elapsed-time deadline as the existing-invoice business verdict after Manage invoice was clicked.
Using the BrowserController 10-second default evaluation timeout for an Amazon invoice DOM snapshot.
Allowing a transient order-detail DOM evaluation exception to escape directly as an unclassified upload-flow runtime failure.
Starting the next same-page observation before the preceding 2-second window has returned and logged its failure.
Discarding BrowserController.open result, fabricating a navigation ref without a forensics writer, or using orderId plus invoiceNo as the only repeated-execution identity.
A state-read, geometry-read, snapshot, or wait path that creates a Chrome window or writes any URL.
A detached Promise.race timeout that can leave the prior upload flow running after a terminal task result.
Two Amazon invoice executions concurrently controlling the shared BrowserController.
Starting the next batch invoice because the current order's Manage invoice dialog has not reached an explicit DOM terminal state yet.
Proceeding to upload before target order id, invoice action state, and amount equality are proven.

laws.summary: Local APP batch upload must read the existing Agent upload ledger before per-file upload, pace consecutive real single-upload requests by a governed random 2-to-15-second interval, and recover the exact Seller Central no-actions invoice dialog without refreshing the order page.

clauses.statement: Local APP batch upload must read the existing Agent upload ledger before per-file upload, skip only orders already proven upload_success or already_uploaded for the same order id and invoice number, and pace consecutive real single-upload requests by one governed random 2-to-15-second interval.

appliesTo: docs/法案辅助文件/GrassEye Amazon Invoice Upload Unified Chain 施工图.md
required: Before local batch queue uploads queued PDFs, it reads GET /api/plugins/amazon-invoice-upload/ledger through the existing ledger route.
The local queue builds a lookup by amazonOrderId plus invoiceNo.
Only ledger records with status upload_success or already_uploaded may be skipped before opening Seller Central.
Skipped items must be visible in the queue as already_uploaded with reason skipped_by_upload_ledger and reachedStep upload ledger preflight.
Manage invoice, Manage invoices, Pending, 管理发票, or 待处理 text may locate invoice actions, but must not be sufficient evidence for upload_success or already_uploaded.

After opening Manage invoice / 管理发票, the flow waits until one unique visible dialog is bound to the current amazonOrderId and exposes exactly one explicit terminal branch: a matching uploaded invoice row, a fully rendered upload-ready table plus upload action, or an exact governed read-failure blocker such as 很抱歉，目前没有可用的操作。 or 读取失败.

The real-Chrome Chinese already-uploaded branch is the conjunction of one visible dialog heading 订单<amazonOrderId>的发票, exactly one descendant row containing the exact complete invoiceNo, and the explicit status 由卖家生成 / Seller generated, 成功：已上传 or an equivalent strong uploaded state; the heading, order id or a whole-page row alone is not success evidence.

Only when the unique visible invoice dialog whose title contains the current complete amazonOrderId exposes an exact governed read-failure blocker may the same upload flow execute one recovery: derive a safe point outside that dialog from the live dialog rectangle and viewport, click the blank area, verify within 2 seconds that the blocked dialog disappeared, reopen Manage invoice once, and resume the same AND THEN terminal-state wait; read-failure text from any unrelated dialog must be ignored.
If the dialog is ambiguous, no safe outside point exists, dismissal is not verified, reopening fails, or the exact blocker appears again, the order must stop as review_required before any PDF upload.
APP batch upload and external API upload must use this same plugin-owned recovery through the existing /api/plugins/amazon-invoice-upload/start route.

A still-loading or unchanged Seller Central invoice list remains on the current order; it must never be collapsed into already_uploaded, upload_success, review_required, or permission to start the next order solely because time elapsed.
Failed, blocked, manual-required, invalid, or unknown ledger records must not be skipped.
If the ledger preflight cannot be read, the local queue must fail closed before uploading more files.
Each non-skipped file must still call the existing single-upload route /api/plugins/amazon-invoice-upload/start with one invoicePdf.
The local batch start action is latched and disabled while a batch is running; repeated submit is rejected without creating another request loop.
Duplicate complete amazonOrderId values in the same selected batch are marked invalid before any upload request is sent.

An explicit status equal to review_required, including the task-level operational watchdog result, stops the local batch before the next queued order starts; the reviewRequired metadata boolean alone is never a batch-control command.

An amount_mismatch_skipped item retains that exact status and review metadata in the local queue, increments the visible failed/review count, and continues to the next queued order without attaching the current PDF.

Between two consecutive non-ledger-skipped single-upload requests, the local queue selects exactly one cryptographically generated integer delay from 2000ms through 15000ms after the prior formal terminal result and before the next POST /api/plugins/amazon-invoice-upload/start.

The pacing delay is not consumed by ledger-preflight skips, invalid files, or duplicate files; it does not run before the first real request, after the final real request, or after any result that stops the batch.

upload_success, live already_uploaded, amount_mismatch_skipped, and an ordinary failed result that is allowed to continue all require pacing before the next real request; explicit review_required, blocked_auth, execution busy, task watchdog timeout, and unknown transport outcome stop without pacing or another request.

While pacing, the running latch and disabled Start action remain held and the App Shell exposes the selected delay and next start timestamp without writing a second batch ledger or changing the prior item terminal result.
forbidden: Skipping based on website export state.
Skipping based on filename alone.
Skipping failed, review_required, blocked_auth, manual_required, or invalid records.
Branching business logic from reason.includes("already uploaded") instead of the formal already_uploaded status.
Adding a second batch ledger, second batch route, or second upload service to support resume.
Uploading all selected PDFs in one multipart request.
Refreshing or reopening the order-detail URL as recovery for the no-actions Manage invoice dialog.
Using hard-coded, caller-provided, API-provided, or APP-provided coordinates to dismiss the dialog.
Retrying the outside-dialog dismissal or Manage invoice reopen more than once.
Keeping the retired order-refresh recovery as a fallback, compatibility bridge, or shadow branch.
Allowing double-submit to create two local batch loops.
Sending an upload request for a duplicate complete order id in the same local batch.
Continuing the local batch after an explicit review_required status or treating a still-loading invoice dialog as a completed item.

Converting amount_mismatch_skipped into review_required, breaking the local queue from reviewRequired metadata, or preventing the next queued order from starting after an amount mismatch has been recorded.
Using caller input, API input, environment overrides, Math.random, a fixed-delay fallback, or a second scheduler to choose the inter-item pacing delay.

Delaying ledger-only skips, delaying before the first real request or after the last real request, consuming the pending delay before a ledger skip, or starting the next real request earlier than the selected delay.
Continuing after task watchdog timeout, execution busy, explicit review_required, blocked_auth, or an unknown single-upload transport outcome.

Declaring the changed API website return path production verified from logs, acceptance strings, or pre-change upload evidence alone.
Adding a second browser controller, second upload task chain, second route, or compatibility wrapper for tab return.

laws.summary: Before any approved invoice PDF is attached or submitted, Amazon invoice upload must compare the PDF gross payable amount with the live Seller Central order DOM total and skip the item on mismatch or unreadable evidence.

clauses.statement: Before any approved invoice PDF is attached or submitted, Amazon invoice upload must compare the PDF gross payable amount with the live Seller Central order DOM total and skip the item on mismatch or unreadable evidence.

required: The amount gate runs inside the existing amazon-invoice-upload flow after the target order detail and already-uploaded state are proven, and before opening the upload invoice entry.

The task record and ledger reason must include a concise safe skip reason without logging raw PDF text, raw DOM HTML, cookies, browser storage, or local absolute PDF paths.
API-triggered uploads and App Shell batch uploads must both pass through the same single-upload amount gate.
forbidden: Opening the upload dialog before the amount gate passes.
Calling uploadApprovedInvoice before the amount gate passes.
Treating filename, APP amount, website export amount, or caller-provided amount as order total truth.
Running a separate APP-only or API-only amount checker that can disagree with the flow result.
Stopping the remaining App Shell batch solely because an amount_mismatch_skipped item carries reviewRequired true.
Uploading when PDF total or Seller Central DOM total is unreadable.
Logging raw PDF text, full DOM HTML, cookies, browser storage, or local absolute invoicePdfPath as amount evidence.

laws.summary: Amazon Product Mining must live as one explicit business job flow under src/plugins/amazon-product-mining and must not become a universal product-discovery agent, ERP, planner, or marketplace crawler framework.

Reusing another plugin as Amazon mining entrypoint.
Universal marketplace crawler abstraction owning Amazon mining state.
ERP, profit calculator, or purchase-decision modules introduced into the plugin owner.
Amazon-specific workflow placed inside any ability group.

laws.summary: Amazon Product Mining must have exactly one active production flow: task intake, AI keyword generation with historical deduplication, keyword queue, Amazon first-page search extraction, product detail extraction, full accessible review extraction, persistence, package generation, PDF generation, and handoff to advanced AI.

clauses.statement: Amazon Product Mining must have exactly one active production flow: task intake, AI keyword generation with historical deduplication, keyword queue, Amazon first-page search extraction, product detail extraction, full accessible review extraction, persistence, package generation, PDF generation, and handoff to advanced AI.

Lite / compact / optional package as an alternative final artifact.
Shadow product decision branch in the flow.
AI next-action planner driving the browser.
Multiple execution modes for the same mining demand.

laws.summary: Amazon Product Mining Agent must not output final product selection, product investment decision, purchase decision, or profit conclusion; it only produces evidence packages for advanced AI decision.

clauses.statement: Amazon Product Mining Agent must not output final product selection, product investment decision, purchase decision, or profit conclusion; it only produces evidence packages for advanced AI decision.

forbidden: Final product selection output produced by Agent code.
Purchase / sampling / listing / inventory / ad-budget recommendation produced by Agent code.
Profit margin conclusion produced by Agent code.
AI prompt asking the model to pick winning products inside this flow.

laws.summary: AI keyword generation must receive existing mined keywords and the system must deduplicate against historical and current-task keywords before mining begins; a task may explicitly choose historical market refresh mode, where historical keyword matches enter the same production queue only with an explicit historical_refresh marker; system prompt text may only add format, deduplication/refresh, marketplace, and explicit boundary requirements, not product-trait assumptions.

clauses.statement: AI keyword generation must receive existing mined keywords and the system must deduplicate against historical and current-task keywords before mining begins; a task may explicitly choose historical market refresh mode, where historical keyword matches enter the same production queue only with an explicit historical_refresh marker; system prompt text may only add format, deduplication/refresh, marketplace, and explicit boundary requirements, not product-trait assumptions.

forbidden: AI keyword request without injecting historical mined keywords.
Executing AI natural-language output directly as mining queue.
Mining the same keyword again without task-scoped keywordHistoryPolicy=refresh_historical_keywords and an explicit historical_refresh marker.
Agent fabricating keywords to fill requested count.
System prompt adding size, weight, small-item, lightweight, compact, shipping, price, material, or other product-trait constraints that the user did not explicitly request.
Treating China supplier background as an instruction to narrow keywords by dimensions, low volume, low weight, or ease of shipping.

laws.summary: For each keyword, the system must extract all visible products on the first Amazon search results page and preserve rank, sponsored status, URL, visible commercial fields, and raw page evidence.

clauses.statement: For each keyword, the system must extract all visible products on the first Amazon search results page and preserve rank, sponsored status, URL, visible commercial fields, and raw page evidence.

forbidden: Extracting only a subset of visible first-page products.
Losing rankPosition or isSponsored on result items.
Dropping a product because ASIN is not visible while productUrl exists.
Opening product detail before search results are persisted.
Mining beyond the first search results page in this flow.

laws.summary: For each stored search result item, the system must open the product detail page and extract all currently visible and accessible product information before review extraction.

clauses.statement: For each stored search result item, the system must open the product detail page and extract all currently visible and accessible product information before review extraction.

forbidden: Extracting only shallow fields like title/price/rating.
Throwing on missing optional fields; missing fields must be null or empty array.
Missing raw visible text snapshot for the detail page.
Deleting search-result evidence when detail extraction fails.

laws.summary: For each product, the system must paginate and persist all currently accessible reviews under the current environment, account, region, language, and sorting condition; bypassing restrictions is forbidden.

clauses.statement: For each product, the system must paginate and persist all currently accessible reviews under the current environment, account, region, language, and sorting condition; bypassing restrictions is forbidden.

forbidden: Skipping review pages (no jumping ahead).
Extracting only the first review page.
Persisting only AI summaries in place of raw reviews.
Bypassing captcha, login walls, region restrictions, or platform risk controls.
Deleting product-detail records when review extraction fails.

laws.summary: Every visible and accessible Amazon search/detail/review field that exists on the current page must be maximally extracted, while every missing or blocked field must be disclosed with an honest reason in completeness and exception artifacts.

clauses.statement: Every visible and accessible Amazon search/detail/review field that exists on the current page must be maximally extracted, while every missing or blocked field must be disclosed with an honest reason in completeness and exception artifacts.

Returning completed while review pagination stopped because of a hidden default page cap.
Marking page-visible fields as not_present without executing the owner extraction strategies for that field.
Package completeness or master report hiding missing-field reasons behind plain null or empty-array output.

clauses.statement: Raw visible page text, extracted records, page URLs, timestamps, and evidence indexes are sovereign records; structured summaries and PDF sections must not replace raw evidence.

forbidden: Structured summary replacing raw page text.
PDF section replacing structured data package.
AI summary replacing raw review records.
Discarding URLs / timestamps / failure reasons.

clauses.statement: Login walls, captchas, account risk pages, region restrictions, unavailable pages, and platform blocks must produce failed or completed_with_errors records; bypassing restrictions and delegating recovery to humans are forbidden.

forbidden: Bypassing captcha, login walls, 2FA, region restrictions, or platform risk controls.
Reading cookie / token / localStorage / sessionStorage.
Fabricating success when extraction is blocked.
Treating partial pass / warning as completed.

clauses.statement: The final artifacts of Amazon Product Mining are a structured data package, a PDF report, an evidence index, and an exception summary; no alternative final artifact chain may replace them.

forbidden: PDF-only delivery without structured data package.
AI summary-only delivery without raw evidence.
Multiple conflicting versions of the data package.
Manually editing generated artifacts as source of truth.

laws.summary: Advanced AI handoff must receive the PDF report, structured data package, raw evidence index, exception summary, and task scope; the handoff must disclose incomplete data and must not invent missing evidence.

clauses.statement: Advanced AI handoff must receive the PDF report, structured data package, raw evidence index, exception summary, and task scope; the handoff must disclose incomplete data and must not invent missing evidence.

forbidden: Handoff missing PDF / package / evidence index / exception summary.
Handoff inventing evidence not present in the package.
Handoff carrying final product selection produced by Agent.

laws.summary: Amazon Product Mining production readiness must be enforced by owner inspector, acceptance tests, generated audit plan, and npm run ci:full; warning-only or partial pass must not be called complete.

clauses.statement: Amazon Product Mining production readiness must be enforced by owner inspector, acceptance tests, generated audit plan, and npm run ci:full; warning-only or partial pass must not be called complete.

forbidden: Warning-only enforcement for P0 clauses.
Hand-editing generated registry / matrix / plan as source of truth.
Bypassing codex-entry-gate.
Local-only acceptance that is not wired into ci:full.
Treating partial pass / soft pass as complete.

laws.summary: Amazon Product Mining must emit one fixed master evidence package root with the frozen section tree, fixed report names, fixed manifest names, and fixed handoff document bundle.

clauses.statement: Amazon Product Mining must emit one fixed master evidence package root with the frozen section tree, fixed report names, fixed manifest names, and fixed handoff document bundle.

Flattening review evidence, handoff docs, or completeness docs back into one loose JSON blob.
Changing fixed report / manifest / handoff artifact names without law change.
PDF or handoff docs stored outside the fixed package root.

laws.summary: The package must disclose image evidence in url_only mode, persist per-product reviews.jsonl, emit completeness and integrity reports, and only mark handoff ready when failure reasons and manual-required reasons are empty, keyword review issues are absent, and package integrity passes.

clauses.statement: The package must disclose image evidence in url_only mode, persist per-product reviews.jsonl, emit completeness and integrity reports, and only mark handoff ready when failure reasons and manual-required reasons are empty, keyword review issues are absent, and package integrity passes.

forbidden: image-evidence-index pretending to be downloaded binary proof instead of url_only evidence.
Mixing all review rows into one task-wide file that loses per-product traceability.
handoffStatus=ready while failureReasons is non-empty.
handoffStatus=ready while manualRequiredReasons is non-empty.
handoffStatus=ready while packageIntegrityStatus is failed.
handoffStatus=ready while any keyword opportunity review is failed or manual_required.
Master package omitting keyword opportunity review status, decision, references, or failure reasons.
exception-summary or data-completeness-report omitting failed/manual_required keyword opportunity reviews.
Hiding missing artifacts, missing fields, or partial review coverage.

laws.summary: Amazon Product Mining export must be able to emit amazon-product-mining-package-{taskId}.zip as a transport wrapper over the fixed package root; the zip is delivery packaging, not a second source-of-truth chain.

clauses.statement: Amazon Product Mining export must be able to emit amazon-product-mining-package-{taskId}.zip as a transport wrapper over the fixed package root; the zip is delivery packaging, not a second source-of-truth chain.

Flattened zip payload that omits amazon-product-mining-package-{taskId}/ as the archive root.
Manual repack workflow outside the owner export surface.
A second export chain with different files than the fixed package root.

laws.summary: Keyword opportunity review is a keywordId-scoped automated screening stage that judges whether a keyword product pool deserves downstream validation; it is not final product adjudication, procurement, profit, launch guidance, or a manual recovery queue.

clauses.statement: Keyword opportunity review is a keywordId-scoped automated screening stage that judges whether a keyword product pool deserves downstream validation; it is not final product adjudication, procurement, profit, launch guidance, or a manual recovery queue.

forbidden: Keyword review deciding final product selection.
Keyword review outputting procurement, sampling, place-order, inventory, launch-listing, or ad-budget advice.
Automatically entering procurement, sampling, listing, or launch stages from keyword verdict.
Treating one keyword review as task-global product adjudication.
Persisting manual_required keyword review records.
Exposing manual-ingest routes, schemas, or public facade methods for keyword review.

clauses.statement: Keyword opportunity review must persist one structured verdict contract with fixed decision enums, fixed dimension enums, fixed human next-step enums, and raw AI proof.

humanNextStep outside enter_next_validation / mine_related_keywords / reject / rerun_or_collect_more_data.

required: Order, stage, raw response, provider proof and event truth persist in SQLite.
Every raw response hash uses canonical sha256-prefixed identity and byte-verified metadata repair preserves already completed analysis.
The default production window is ten and cloud claims subtract active local work.
A recoverable stage retries with bounded backoff under the live heartbeating lease so independent graph branches complete their required submissions before order-level deferral.

Restart resumes a durable submitted turn without duplicate prompt submission. Recoverable transport faults retain the same execution id and logical-turn marker, whether they happen before or after submission. Only a proven polluted or invalid completed answer, or a genuinely terminal pre-submit identity fault, creates a fresh execution id and fresh marker; a captured submission always resumes instead of sending again.
Restart reconciliation reclaims the original cloud job before local execution and republishes any already completed local result under a fresh lease.
A cloud-confirmed foreign-device recovery ledger is durably quarantined as review_required once and is excluded from later automatic restart reconciliation.
Only one order or stage for the same exact webChatUrl may submit at a time, in createdAt and orderId FIFO order.
Fork siblings use different conversation scopes and provider URLs, may execute in parallel within bounded capacity, and never share a same-conversation FIFO lane.

Restart, disconnect, lease takeover and disaster rebuild preserve frozen subject, participant manifest, parent checkpoint, child scope and provider proof; downstream stays blocked when a rebuilt parent raw hash differs.

Historical paid follow-ups without a continuation parent remain recovery_pending until the website reissues their immutable parent identity; an exact one-way local repair preserves old stage evidence and users never receive an ordinary runtime failure.

Provider citation residue, private-use characters, invalid required JSON and missing raw output are discarded and restarted with a fresh execution id and fresh marker, while a transport retry never duplicates one already submitted logical turn merely because page-global turn counts changed during provider hydration.

A failed or review_required gateway execution with durable submission proof always resumes the same execution id, marker and provider conversation. A fresh execution is allowed only for a proven polluted or invalid completed answer, or a genuinely terminal pre-submit identity fault.

A failed or review_required attachment upload proof is terminal for that attachment execution: same-lease loops, restart recovery and new leases preserve its proof and never call the Gateway upload again without explicit operator authorization.
A missing local or provider parent conversation is reconstructed from the lease-bound parent replay package and persisted in production_parent_conversation_rebuilds.
